tess_cs: Proposal: a tiny 24/72h/7d pulse after onboarding to capture happy(bool), rating(1-5), short note. Use to auto-adjust healthscore and trigger a micro-playbook for red signals. Thoughts?

sam_ops: Good. Keep payload minimal. I'll own dedupe/backoff and opt-out checks.

leo_data: For mapping, suggest simple rule: score = rating - (happy?0:2) - (urgent_text?3:0). Urgent keywords: billing,error,blocked. Will provide mapping file.

max_eng: Receiver should be idempotent on (customer_id,milestone). Return 202, log to onboarding_feedback_raw. Feature flag rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

cs-bot: deploy-bot: created PR #501 for onboard-pulse receiver.

tess_cs: Owners assigned: ops (@sam_ops), data (@leo_data), eng (@max_eng). Maya will draft playbooks later. Sync Thursday to confirm rollout.
